about: A scenario overriding a derived node.

files.model.yaml:
dsl: 2
model: tiny
title: Overrides arithmetic
currency: USD

nodes:

  request_rate:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: request/second
    value: 200
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the busy hour, as stated for this case"}

  service_demand:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: core*second/request
    value: 0.02
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "processor time per request, as stated for this case"}

  cores:
    kind: input
    decided: you
    unit: core
    value: 16
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the fleet chosen for this case"}

  busy_cores:
    kind: derived
    unit: core
    formula: request_rate * service_demand

  utilisation:
    kind: derived
    unit: dimensionless
    formula: busy_cores / cores

outputs:
  - utilisation
files.scenarios/reference.yaml:
scenario: reference
title: Reference
because: the model as declared
samples: 1000
seed: 20260916
overrides:
  busy_cores: 12

provenance.source: the fleet chosen for this case
the busy hour, as stated for this case
processor time per request, as stated for this case

problems.message: _builder_conformance/scenario-overrides-derived/model.yaml: scenario 'reference' overrides 'busy_cores', which is derived. Pin the inputs it comes from instead, or the graph and the number disagree.
